recovery.reason: Continue requested after blocked device acceptance. Preserve host implementation and run only next bounded read-only cable preflight in a fresh session.

authorization.scope: Only next previously named step: cable-connected read-only preflight. No installation, device writes, restart, firmware or Developer Mode action.

recovery.ownership: Prior child reported done and pane was closed. Current Herdr listing contains no agent in source worktree.
recovery.reservations: Inspector returned start/takeover and no active owner or goal reservation; existing claim retained.
recovery.workspace_observation: Prior workspace w6N no longer exists after last pane closure. Existing worktree is unchanged; reopened as w6P.
device_limits: Use verified known SSH host key and cable endpoint only. Never accept-new or bypass host verification.
Read model, architecture, firmware, stock binary hash, dependency versions and file metadata only.
Inspect only named installation paths and launcher collisions. Never read credentials, pairing records, drafts or notebook contents.
Stop on unavailable cable, authentication/host-key failure, unsupported device or ambiguous compatibility.
No service stops, restarts, installs, deletions, chmod, remounts, firewall or cloud/account changes.
